verdict.rationale: HubSpot's first-party docs state that the webhooks journal API lets third-party integrators subscribe to real-time events, retrieve historical event data and manage CRM object snapshots, which directly covers the core of the story. The pack contains only that single docs snippet on webhooks, with no detail on setup, event types or delivery guarantees. missing for 10: details on subscription setup and supported event types, delivery/retry/signature-verification documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
